journey.name: Local controller and navigation
journey.description: Start on Controller, Bluetooth stopped, default preset, window large enough to show controls. No receiver required. Held-state assertions need continuous touch plus observation; ordinary completed adb swipes only verify release.

actions.action: Verify that the controller shows Not connected and Local controls.
Drag the left stick away from its touch origin, then release it.
Verify that LS displays (0%, 0%) after release.
Drag the right stick away from its touch origin, then release it.
Verify that RS displays (0%, 0%) after release.
Press and release the A button.
Press and release the left trigger.
Press and release the right trigger.
Verify that LT: 0 and RT: 0 are displayed.
Verify that the drawer is closed and the controller is visible.
Verify that Bluetooth connection is visible.
Verify that both sticks and both triggers display neutral values.
